selection: All six dataset/arm LR choices and twelve selected run checkpoints sealed together before first TEST access
primary: Masked channel-macro MSE in the original TRAIN-standardized coordinates after native inverse normalization
combined: Pool A/B channel error sums and observed counts before division; then mean channels
seed_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the two selected seeds' losses; never prediction ensemble
references: Hash-bound existing F0/LEVEL/MSE-LoRA/native-LoRA/NLinear/Mini/Tiny/Chronos-2 results, respecting original method and evidence scope

bootstrap.sampling: A/B stratified moving contiguous noncircular blocks; sample ceil(n/block) starts uniformly from 0..n-block inclusive; concatenate then truncate to n; preserve paired origin/channel/seed losses
bootstrap.combined: Add period bootstrap occurrence weights, then pool channel sums/counts
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile interval of paired mean-seed loss differences and relative changes; temporal resampling uncertainty, not independent domains

interpretation: OUTPUT mixes channels while HEAD is channel-independent. Their difference is not pure information effect. S1 historical LoRA gaps are not matched head-parent internal-adaptation effects.
